description: Folder taxonomy of the CoolSolve Library. A model's category is its parent folder under models/. Kind, level and status are facets stored in model.json (see docs/taxonomy.md). Change this file together with the folders (docs/taxonomy.md, section 'Changing the taxonomy').

categories.title: Fundamentals
categories.description: Thermodynamic basics: properties, processes, first and second law, combustion chemistry.

children.title: Properties
children.description: Thermophysical properties, equations of state, ideal gases, mixtures, phase change.

children.title: Processes
children.description: Closed- and open-system processes, energy and entropy balances, exergy, textbook exercises.

children.title: Combustion
children.description: Stoichiometry, excess air, heating values, flue-gas properties (e.g. cpbar), adiabatic flame temperature, chemical equilibrium and dissociation.

categories.title: Heat transfer
categories.description: Heat-transfer mechanisms and correlations, independent of a specific component.

children.title: Conduction
children.description: Walls, fins, insulation, transient conduction.

children.title: Convection
children.description: Single- and two-phase convection correlations (often function libraries), boiling, condensation.

children.title: Radiation
children.description: Radiative exchange, view factors, solar radiation on surfaces.

children.title: Pressure drop
children.description: Friction factors and two-phase pressure-drop / void-fraction correlations.

categories.title: Components
categories.description: Models of a single piece of equipment (design, off-design or semi-empirical).

children.title: Heat exchangers
children.description: NTU/LMTD, multi-zone and discretised exchangers, condensers, evaporators, regenerators, plate/fin-tube/shell-and-tube.

children.title: Compressors
children.description: Reciprocating, scroll, screw, centrifugal compressors; semi-empirical and map-based models.

children.title: Expanders and turbines
children.description: Volumetric expanders, steam/gas/ORC turbines, turbomachinery similarity.

children.title: Pumps and fans
children.description: Pumps, fans, blowers, characteristic curves, similarity laws.

children.title: Valves, nozzles and piping
children.description: Expansion valves, nozzles, ejectors, pipes and networks, fittings.

children.title: Boilers and burners
children.description: Boilers, furnaces, burners, flue-gas heat recovery.

children.title: Storage
children.description: Sensible, latent (PCM, ice) and thermochemical storage; tanks; batteries when thermally modelled.

children.title: Instrumentation and flow metering
children.description: Flow metering (orifice plates, nozzles, ISO 5167), sensors and measurement data reduction.

categories.title: Cycles and machines
categories.description: Complete thermodynamic cycles and machines made of several components.

children.title: Steam power cycles
children.description: Rankine cycles with water/steam: reheat, regeneration, power plants.

children.title: Organic Rankine cycles
children.description: ORC and other vapour power cycles with organic fluids or CO2 (transcritical).

children.title: Gas turbines and gas cycles
children.description: Brayton cycles, gas turbines, combined cycles, supercritical CO2 Brayton, air cycles.

children.title: Engines
children.description: Internal combustion engines (Otto, Diesel), Stirling and Ericsson engines.

children.title: Refrigeration and heat pumps
children.description: Vapour-compression refrigeration, heat pumps, multi-stage, transcritical CO2, ejector cycles.

children.title: Absorption and sorption
children.description: Absorption (NH3-H2O, LiBr-H2O), adsorption and desiccant cycles.

children.title: Psychrometrics
children.description: Humid-air properties and elementary processes (mixing, heating, humidification, dehumidification).

children.title: Air handling
children.description: Cooling/heating coils, air handling units, evaporative coolers, heat recovery on air.

children.title: Cooling towers and evaporative equipment
children.description: Wet and hybrid cooling towers, evaporative condensers and coolers.

children.title: Solar thermal
children.description: Solar collectors, concentrating solar power, solar ORC, solar cooling.

children.title: Photovoltaics
children.description: PV cell/module electrical-thermal models.

children.title: Geothermal and biomass
children.description: Geothermal plants, ground-source heat exchangers and borefields, biomass conversion.

categories.title: Buildings
categories.description: Building thermal models (RC networks, zones, envelope), terminal units (radiators, cooling ceilings), thermal comfort, building energy systems.

children.title: Cogeneration
children.description: CHP and trigeneration plants.

children.title: District heating and cooling
children.description: Networks, substations, heat distribution.

children.title: Economics
children.description: Investment, cost and thermo-economic evaluation.
